messages.subject: Tempest - covenant reset / equity cure - internal thoughts
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Tom,

Quick internal note before the docs call. On the equity cure, Pemberton Rowe will likely push for one cure per year; we should hold for two (and four over the life), with no more than two in consecutive quarters - the client needs the flexibility given the seasonality in WCB's numbers.

On leverage, the 5.00x opening level gives roughly 0.8x headroom against Marlow's base case at Dec-25, tightening to almost nothing by Sep-26, so the cure right is doing real work. I'd resist any attempt to drop the opening level below 4.75x.

Tom - can you build the covenant headroom grid off Marlow's model for the call?

James

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
